card.name: Given names or initials before surnames
card.fires_on: A first name, middle initial, or period after an initial, right before a surname, in local-history or genealogy text about early settlers.

modes.label: Initial or period
modes.description: The middle initial or its period inside a person's name, just before the surname.
modes.example: Nahum N<<.>> Wilson, for the town of Thet

modes.label: First name before surname
modes.description: A first name of a settler or family member, with the surname still to come.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward predicting a surname next, such as Chap, Kel, Haz, or Whitney.
card.plain: It fires when a pioneer's first name or initial has just been read and the family name is about to come.
